title: Role-based learning
description: Different users need different pathways: students, donors, community leaders, teachers, technologists, health workers, peacebuilders, and organizations.

title: Practice-based learning
description: Users should create outputs: briefings, workshops, action plans, checklists, partner questions, and project designs.

title: Simulation-based learning
description: Users should practice decision-making in simplified but realistic scenarios.

title: Relational learning
description: Learning can happen alone, in teams, in workshops, in campus labs, in community learning circles, or in partner projects.

title: Capacity-based learning
description: Learning pathways connect to capacities needed at individual, community, organizational, and system levels.

title: Continuous improvement
description: Learning should include reflection, feedback, adaptation, and improvement over time.
